Designed multi‑stage agent pipelines and evaluation mechanisms, and automated data validation pipelines. Strong knowledge of APIs, cloud infrastructure, and modern development practices, and proven ability to grasp new domains quickly.

Developed multi‑signal Python trading engine combining indicators, sentiment, and political triggers with backtesting and grid‑search optimization.
